sentences.text: Social worker Hannah Price (S1) identified as being from Harbridge children's services.
School contacted social worker because Millie told her teacher she did not want to go home on Monday.
Millie's family members living at the address are Stacey Lambert (mother), Craig Lambert (stepfather), Millie, and Jayden (2 years old).
Craig is Millie's stepfather; the couple has been together for four years.
Millie's biological father is in Scotland and they see him during summer holidays.
Millie Lambert (S3) is 9 years old, in Year Four.
The landlord is slow to fix damp in Millie's room.
Millie has a hamster named Biscuit.
Millie reported that Jayden takes her pens.
Millie reported that she did not want to go home on Monday because of the bed.
Millie likes doing art at school and is in the netball team.
Millie disclosed that Craig hits her with a belt on her legs and the back of her legs when she wets the bed.
Millie stated Craig hits her 'like every week' and 'every time I wet the bed'.
Millie reported the last incident happened on Sunday morning before Mum got up.
Millie reported seeing red lines from the hitting which went away.
Millie disclosed that no one else at home hurts her.
Millie disclosed that her mum never hits her and gives her cuddles.
Social worker Hannah Price (S1) stated that Millie told her Craig hits her with a belt on her legs when she wets the bed, and that it happens about every week.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated Craig gives Millie a smack with his belt now and again on her legs, and that it is not hard.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated she has seen Craig hit Millie once or twice.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated Craig is from a strict family.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated she told Craig to stop hitting Millie.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated that the hitting is just a smack and is not abuse.
Social worker Hannah Price (S1) stated that hitting a child with a belt is not acceptable and she has to act on it.
Social worker Hannah Price (S1) stated she is going to speak to her manager and the police today, which is called a strategy discussion.
Stacey Lambert (S2) asked if Craig is going to get arrested.
Social worker Hannah Price (S1) stated she does not know yet if Craig will get arrested.
Social worker Hannah Price (S1) asked Stacey to keep Craig away from the house until they spoke again.
Stacey works mornings at Greggs; Craig works full time on the bins.
Stacey Lambert (S2) stated Craig's brother is on Canal Street and could take Craig there.
